propositions: structured_run.py exceeds the 500-LOC refactoring target at 796 LOC and is within 4 lines of the 800-LOC hard cap, blocking further additions.
The module conflates three distinct responsibilities: run orchestration, cache-effectiveness diagnostics, and failure interpretation, requiring decomposition by responsibility.

Cache diagnostics cluster (warn_if_cache_ineffective, cache_write_never_read, warn_if_cache_write_never_read, estimate_marked_prefix_tokens, _warn_if_zeroed_usage) must be extracted to cache_diagnostics.py.
Failure interpretation cluster (FailureContext, interpret_failure, _write_parse_failure_artifact) must be extracted to run_failure.py.
All moved symbols must be re-exported from structured_run.py to preserve external import paths and avoid editing downstream consumers and tests.
After split, structured_run.py must be ≤500 LOC, each new module ≥100 LOC, and all prior import paths must remain functional.
